answer: An attester must stake 46% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. Because the voyage stake is held until the thread settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the karst audit lists each exposure. A farm running 98 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
